summary: A mature v1.0.0 zero-dependency Pure-Node B2B contract & AGB auditing engine (`src/analyze.js`, `src/clausedb.js`, `src/compare.js`, `src/pdfextract.js`, `src/docxextract.js`, `src/pdfreport.js`) with 47+ deterministic BGB §§ 305–310 detectors, SARIF 2.1.0 output, and extensive stress/red-team test corpora.

tasks.title: Harden multi-paragraph BGB § 309 Nr. 7 liability carve-out resolution in analyze.js
tasks.spec:
Verify and harden cross-sentence / cross-paragraph context window resolution in `src/analyze.js` so that liability caps that validly exempt *Vorsatz*, *grobe Fahrlässigkeit*, *Kardinalpflichten*, and *Verletzung von Leben, Körper, Gesundheit* (§ 309 Nr. 7a/b BGB) in an adjacent sentence are not false-flagged, while caps missing any mandatory carve-out are deterministically flagged.

1. Add targeted regression tests in `test/analyze.test.js`.

tasks.title: Verify negotiation delta risk-score regression tracking in compare.js
tasks.spec:
Ensure `src/compare.js` computes a deterministic `NegotiationGateVerdict` (`APPROVED`, `REQUIRES_REDLINE`, `REJECTED_NEW_HIGH_RISK`) when comparing an original contract against a counterparty redline, explicitly listing resolved findings, persistent blockers, and newly introduced risk clauses.

1. Add unit tests in `test/compare.test.js`.
